why: Inserting the fallback changed tie-breaking so the model now prefers to keep numeral/quantifier+unit and finite-verb+immediate-complement adjacencies, which fixed a handful of short/numeric cases but—by demoting punctuation/clause boundaries—moved many cuts into prepositional/quote boundaries and other internal spots; bins show small gains for very short pieces (≤3, ≤7) but slight losses across mid and long bins (≤5, ≤10, ≤99), producing a near-zero net effect.
lesson: Don’t demote punctuation and clause boundaries so far in the tie-breaking order that modest numeral/unit/verb–complement protections cause many small regressions across medium and long spans.
